order_wins: **ARSS Infrastructure Projects** -- work order of Rs 131.10 cr from Northern Railway for Important Bridge no. 75 on the Jaunpur-Zafrabad doubling (mcap not in store; ratio not computable).
**Artefact Projects** -- Letter of Award for Authority's Engineer consultancy on NH-16 O&M works in Odisha, fee Rs 3.50 cr excl GST (~9.4% of mcap).
**Shayona Engineering** -- purchase order of Rs 1.87 cr incl GST from an undisclosed domestic customer for engineering components (~2.1% of mcap).
**Skytech Infinite Platform** -- purchase orders totalling Rs 1.07 cr for PLC/SCADA panels at three water-supply schemes in Athani taluk, Karnataka (~3.8% of mcap).

**ACME Solar Holdings** -- subsidiary ACME Greentech Sixteen signs a PPA with Rewa Ultra Mega Solar for a 220 MW solar-plus-BESS project at Morena, Madhya Pradesh (voluntary disclosure; value not stated).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **SML Mahindra** -- Board fixes terms of its already-approved rights issue: 41,34,756 shares at Rs 3,506, 2 for every 7 held, up to Rs 1,449.65 cr, record date 20-Nov, open 1-9 Dec (~19.3% of mcap).
**Urban Company** -- QIP opens today at a floor price of Rs 161.03 per share, up to 5% discount allowed; issue size not stated.
equity_allotments: **Galactico Corporate Services** -- allots 1,80,00,000 new warrants at Rs 2.03 (Rs 3.65 cr) to a promoter-group member, 25% received (~10.6% of mcap).
**Sat Kartar Life** -- allots 5,50,000 new warrants at Rs 172 to promoter-category allottees, Rs 9.46 cr (our arithmetic), at least 25% received, balance within 18 months.
**Prime Fresh** -- converts earlier-issued warrants: allots 1,13,700 equity shares to Hiren Ghelani after the 75% balance, Rs 1.86 cr in all (our arithmetic; past warrants).
m_and_a: **Jindal Saw** -- subsidiary JITF Shipyards agrees to sell its 83,98,446 shares (89.82%) of Jindal Intellicom to that company's CEO for Rs 15.45 cr, completion by 30-Nov; target turnover Rs 27.52 cr.

**Sai Parenterals** -- Board approves buying a majority of Hyderabad formulations firm Bion Therapeutics via subsidiary SP Analytics, all cash, funded from IPO general-corporate-purpose proceeds and debt; price not disclosed.
**State Bank of India** -- completes acquisition of 29,70,000 shares (9.90%) of CareEdge Global IFSC; price not stated.
**Nisus Finance** -- its Nisus High Yield Growth Fund buys Adaire 1 & 2, a pre-leased Dubai residential building (104 flats, 8 retail units); price not stated.
**P N Gadgil Jewellers** -- to set up a 76%-owned manufacturing subsidiary for diamond and gold jewellery, initial investment up to Rs 10 cr from internal accruals.
**Anka India** -- the amalgamation of Futech Internet into Anka becomes effective after Form INC-28 is filed with the RoC.
**Warren Tea** -- board meets 24-Nov to take on record the NCLT order of 5-Nov sanctioning its amalgamation with Maple Hotels & Resorts.
**PBM Polytex** -- signs an agreement to sell a 600 kW Kutch wind-mill undertaking to Khodiyar Trading for Rs 39.50 lakh plus GST, completion by Feb-2027.
**Pioneer Embroideries** -- sells its vacant Sarigam GIDC land and building to Alchemy Interchem for Rs 1.89 cr, proceeds for working capital.
capex_core: **Megatherm Induction** -- intends to expand its Kharagpur transformer division to two sheds, Rs 70.05 cr in two phases (Rs 39.75 cr + Rs 30.30 cr, incl working capital).
business_updates: **Results season** — 187 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Senco Gold** -- highest-ever festive retail net sales above Rs 2,426 cr for 1-Oct to 11-Nov, +26% YoY, same-store sales +17%, 10 new showrooms.
**Black Rose Industries** -- Q2 FY27 standalone revenue Rs 91.25 cr (+8.2% YoY), EBITDA Rs 15.67 cr (+107.7%), PAT Rs 10.49 cr (+136.7%).
**Gopal Snacks** -- wafers revenue rose 40.0% YoY to Rs 58 cr in Q2 FY27 (volume +39.7%); launches Rs 10 consumer schemes on its Cristos wafers.
**Hinduja Global Solutions** -- signs a three-year engineering and digital services collaboration with Rackspace Technology; value not disclosed.
**PTC Industries** -- H1 FY27 total income +77.3% YoY, EBITDA +116.9%, PAT +168% over H1 FY26.
**Supreme Infrastructure India** -- Q2 revenue +114.8% YoY and its first profitable quarter after the Scheme; says it is debt free.
**S A Tech Software India** -- H1 FY27 total income +37% YoY, EBITDA margin more than doubles.
**Current Infraprojects** -- H1 FY27 total income Rs 53.60 cr, PAT Rs 5.01 cr.
**V.L. Infraprojects** -- H1 FY27 total income Rs 71.79 cr, +14.14% YoY.
**Repono** -- H1 FY27 total income +21.6% YoY to Rs 37.35 cr, net profit +8.9% to Rs 3.51 cr.
**Unihealth Hospitals** -- H1 FY27 revenue +15% YoY to Rs 76.45 cr, operating cash flow Rs 23.83 cr.
**Shivashrit Foods** -- H1 FY27 net profit +24% YoY, EBITDA margin 25.1%.
**Kaushalya Logistics** -- H1 FY27 consolidated total income Rs 99,788.83 lakh (as printed); net profit +14.8% half-on-half.
**Advani Hotels & Resorts** -- total income +8.8% YoY in Q2 and +7.0% in H1 FY27.
**Capital Trust** -- AUM crosses Rs 300 cr in Q2 FY27, +32% QoQ, gross NPA 2.2%, 79% of the portfolio secured.
**Biocon** -- US FDA approves Pebrilzo (pertuzumab-qcay), a biosimilar to Perjeta, for its oncology portfolio.
**Glenmark** -- its US arm launches an authorized generic of Inlyta (axitinib) tablets; the brand's US sales were about $538.4 mn in the 12 months to Sep-2026 (IQVIA, as quoted).
**Mercury EV-Tech** -- MoU with Lilongwe City Council, Malawi, to explore 150 electric buses and a local EV assembly plant; non-binding, no value.
distress_risk: **Knowledge Realty Trust** -- Gurugram District Court (11-Nov order) says asset SPV One Qube Realtors is not liable for any part of the decretal award, while rejecting its objections; the SPV plans to appeal.
other_notable: **FDC** -- submits the Letter of Offer for its tender-offer buyback of 24,00,000 shares at Rs 500, up to Rs 120 cr (board approved 27-Oct; ~2.0% of mcap).
**T T Limited** -- Board unanimously disapproves the proposed buyback of equity shares.
**Kama Holdings** -- board meets 20-Nov to consider a buyback of equity shares; size not stated.
**B-Right Realestate** -- signs a term sheet with HB Group's Super Constructions to redevelop the Chandani Agar SRA project, Wadala; projected GDV about Rs 375 cr, not a contract value.
**PG Foils** -- signs a non-binding Letter of Intent with Bahrain's Ministry of Industry and Commerce for an aluminium-foil facility; no investment or capacity stated.
**Dilip Buildcon** -- receives a provisional completion certificate for its Rs 1,589 cr Maradgi S Andola-Baswantpur hybrid-annuity highway (NH-150C).
**Oneclick Logistics India** -- NSE gives in-principle approval to migrate its shares from NSE Emerge to the Main Board.
**Mayank Cattle Food** -- starts a retail segment with 11 stores in Gujarat through MoUs with local traders, effective 16-Nov.
